reading.body:
Character.AI is a 2022-founded persona chat service whose only listed product carries an HR and appropriate-use risk note.

The data covers one company, one product, and one risk flag. There is no funding figure, no user count, no revenue, no infrastructure detail, and no litigation. So the record establishes what Character.AI is and that its use in workplace or institutional settings is flagged as a concern, and nothing about scale.

That matters for AI because persona chat is a consumer-facing workload, and consumer chat is the least compute-intensive end of the market. The data gives no basis to place Character.AI in the compute or power story at all. It does not say where the models run, who supplies the chips, or how much electricity the service draws.

The honest reading is narrow. A company founded in 2022, verified in 2026, with a single chat product and a standing caution about appropriate use. Everything about its compute footprint, its buildings, and its draw on the grid is absent from this record.
